earnings.title: Emerson Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2026 Results;
highlights: Emerson also declared a 7% quarterly cash dividend increase to $0.595 per share of common stock payable December 10, 2026 to stockholders of record November 13, 2026.

quotes.text: Emerson capped a strong 2026 with fourth quarter sales and profitability exceeding expectations.
quotes.by: Emerson President and Chief Executive Officer Lal Karsanbhai
